teaser.en: Its oily orange fruits were once threaded onto sticks and burned as candles.
teaser.sw: Matunda yake yenye mafuta ya rangi ya chungwa zamani yalitungwa kwenye vijiti na kuwashwa kama mishumaa.

summary.en: *Mtundukula* is the sour plum, a spiny scrambling shrub of the bush with plum-like orange-red fruits. The fruit is eaten, its seeds give oil, and the oily fruits were even used as candles.
summary.sw: *Mtundukula* (kwa Kiingereza *sour plum*) ni kichaka chenye miiba kinachotambaa porini, chenye matunda ya rangi ya chungwa-nyekundu yanayofanana na plamu. Tunda lake huliwa, mbegu zake hutoa mafuta, na matunda yenye mafuta hata yalitumika kama mishumaa.

about.en: *Mtundukula* is a spiny, scrambling shrub with blue-green leaves growing in tufts along the stems. Its fruits look like small plums and ripen to orange-red, with a sharp, sour taste and a large stone inside.
about.sw: *Mtundukula* ni kichaka chenye miiba kinachotambaa, chenye majani ya rangi ya kijani-samawati yanayoota kwa mafungu kando ya mashina. Matunda yake yanafanana na plamu ndogo na huiva kuwa rangi ya chungwa-nyekundu, yakiwa na ladha kali ya uchachu na kokwa kubwa ndani.

where.en: It grows in bushland and wooded grassland.
where.sw: Hukua katika nyika ya vichaka na nyasi zenye miti.

uses.en: The sour fruit is eaten fresh. The seeds give an oil, and the oily fruits were threaded onto sticks and burned as candles. The plant also yields dye and tannin, and it is used in traditional medicine.
uses.sw: Tunda lake chachu huliwa vivi hivi. Mbegu hutoa mafuta, na matunda yenye mafuta yalitungwa kwenye vijiti na kuwashwa kama mishumaa. Mmea huu pia hutoa rangi na tanini, na hutumika katika tiba za jadi.

culture.en: The name is probably a loan from Swahili, read as 'eat fruit' with the Swahili *kula*, 'to eat'; the Digo verb for 'eat' is *rya*.
culture.sw: Huenda jina hili limetoholewa kutoka Kiswahili, likisomeka kama 'tunda-kula' kwa neno la Kiswahili *kula*; kitenzi cha Kidigo cha 'kula' ni *rya*.

names.en: The name *mtundukula* is shared by Digo, Giriama, Chonyi and Swahili; Swahili also has *mpingi*. In English it is the sour plum or false sandalwood.
names.sw: Jina *mtundukula* linatumika katika Kidigo, Kigiriama, Kichonyi na Kiswahili; Kiswahili pia kina *mpingi*. Kwa Kiingereza ni *sour plum* au *false sandalwood*.

reason.en: Wild custard apple, another bush fruit
reason.sw: Mtomoko mwitu, tunda lingine la porini

reason.en: Spiny monkey orange, a wild fruit of the same bushland
reason.sw: Mtonga, tunda la porini la nyika ile ile ya vichaka
